body.x: ECOPEACE Co., Ltd. (CEO Chae Inwon) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will be held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10. The company, known for its AI-based autonomous technology for removing harmful algae, continues to capture attention in the global advanced industry sector.

ECOPEACE has previously introduced eco-friendly robots, such as the solar-powered ECO-BOT and its control and charging station, ECO-STATION. The company delivers these products to domestic public enterprises and local governments. The company aims to accelerate its growth by targeting global markets with region-specific marketing and product development.
At CES 2025, ECOPEACE will unveil its latest innovation, the ‘Healing Boat,’ which boasts advanced functionality and versatility over its predecessors.

body.cap: | Leisure water purification robot 'Healing Boat' | Photo by ECOPEACE

body.x: The Healing Boat autonomously navigates water surfaces, actively removing harmful algae that can harm aquatic life and human health. Its operations are powered entirely by solar panels, making it a sustainable and eco-friendly solution for water purification.

The Healing Boat also enhances the user experience by offering 3D digital content inside the vessel, allowing passengers to explore underwater ecosystems virtually. This unique combination of recreational water activities and environmental protection earned the Healing Boat the CES 2025 Innovation Award in the Smart City category.

An ECOPEACE representative stated, “We are proud to introduce the Healing Boat at CES 2025 to highlight its innovative features and the significance of AI-driven water purification technology globally. This exhibition provides an invaluable platform to attract international interest and foster investment and collaboration in forward-looking environmental technologies.”

The representative added, “ECOPEACE is expanding its global reach, with sales discussions underway in Vietnam and PoC projects for customized water purification robots in Singapore. CES 2025 presents an ideal opportunity to meet buyers from North America and Europe, regions with high demand for freshwater solutions. We aim to connect with water resource management organizations and companies to explore new business opportunities.”

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
